hadith:
Gifts - Narrated Um 'Atiyya:

Once the Prophet (ﷺ) went to `Aisha and asked her whether she had something (to eat). She said that she had nothing except the mutton which Um 'Atiyya had sent to (Barirah) in charity. The Prophet (ﷺ) said that it had reached its destination (i.e. it is no longer an object of charity.)
message: Allah, as Al Badi', uniquely creates all things from nothing, showcasing unparalleled creativity. Reflect on how every detail in our lives is recorded, guiding us towards understanding and resolving differences. Embrace gratitude for these blessings and strive for unity through shared faith and compassion.
name:
Al Badi' - الْبَدِيعُ - The Incomparable Originator

The name Al Badi' signifies Allah's unique ability to create everything from nothing, emphasizing His unmatched creativity and originality in bringing forth the universe. It reflects the concept of being peerless in creation, underscoring that no one can replicate His divine act of creation. This name originates from the Arabic root 'ب-د-ع' (B-D-A), which conveys the sense of initiating and bringing something into existence without any prior example.
verse:
An-Naml - The Ant - 27:75-76

For there is nothing hidden in the heavens or the earth without being ˹written˺ in a perfect Record. 

Indeed, this Quran clarifies for the Children of Israel most of what they differ over.
